spec.title: About this view

options.content:
Can the physical hosts sustain the workload and a site failure?

Missing or partial evidence is Unknown. [Runbook](https://github.com/iT3E/tnwks-ops/blob/main/docs/operations/grafana-resource-budget.md)

spec.description: Purpose, scope and the interpretation of missing evidence.

spec.title: Host state
spec.description:
Each host's resources, graded: CPU busy over 15 minutes (Degraded above 85%, Failed above 95%), RAM in use over 15 minutes (90%, 97%), latency of the slowest busy volume (50 ms, 200 ms) and the fullest volume's free space (below 10%, 5%). Unknown when the host's exporter is down. Click a row for that host's detail.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Windows available memory
spec.description:
Physical host availability. Do not add this to WSL MemAvailable, which overlaps the same memory.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Host CPU busy
spec.description:
Share of each Windows host's logical processors doing work. Click a line for that host's CPU, memory, disk and network detail.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Host disk latency
spec.description:
Average time per disk operation on each host's slowest volume. An SSD normally answers in under 5 ms; sustained above 20 ms the disk is what's slow. Click a line for the host's detail.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Host memory in use

spec.expr: 1 - max by (k8s_cluster, instance) (windows_memory_available_bytes{k8s_cluster=~"$cluster"}) / max by (k8s_cluster, instance) (windows_memory_physical_total_bytes{k8s_cluster=~"$cluster"})

spec.description:
Share of each host's RAM not available to new work (standby cache counts as available). Near 100% with steady paging the host is short of memory. Click a line for its memory detail, commit charge included.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Windows disk free
spec.description:
Physical free space remains authoritative even if an ext4 VHDX reports much more virtual space.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Disk temperature
spec.description:
SMART device temperature where published. Missing SMART data is a collection gap, not a passing disk test.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Required app replicas
spec.description:
Current placement demand. Full survivor-fit evidence also needs measured requests/peaks, storage placement and pinned hardware.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.

spec.title: Recovery readiness
spec.description:
Per warm app: could this site take it over (database, backup, restore drill, fence)? Not applicable where the app runs. Unknown until every prerequisite has evidence. This page does not promise all services fit or fail over.

Observation budget: 180s for current evidence; backup/restore objectives and historical windows are separate. Source contract: observability/generated/panel-contracts.json.
